_comment: The avatar art (Milestone 16, user, 6 Nov 2026): one sheet per age group and sex, made by the team with an AI image tool (CC BY 4.0, README). tools/cut_avatar_sheets.py cuts the originals in assets/art/avatar/source/ into 5 x 5 even cells of the avatar's size; the team upscaled those (source/upscaled/, 7 Nov 2026), and the tool makes one picture per body and face from them, at twice the avatar's size: <folder>/<body>_<face>.png. Bodies and faces are in the order below. mouth_y is the height of the mouth as a share of a cell, from the top (where the meal fork aims). Body: obese, overweight (weight wins over muscular), thin, muscular, otherwise healthy. Face: asleep, tired, sad, happy, otherwise neutral.
